items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: Yeah, same time I did. Same time I did.

ctx.x: You remember when Johnny Dodds was in Ory's band, did he play with same time you did or?
Yeah, same time I did. Same time I did.
Wade had gone when you were playing with him or was he, did he play with Wade too with that group?
